Summer Breeze by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Summer Breeze. Aptly named, discover the allure of this delightful beachside haven, meticulously renovated. Designed for both mental repose and quality time with loved ones, Summer Breeze assures a tranquil retreat amidst the stunning scenery. The beach is right across the street (30A), on the other side of the beachfront homes, with public beach access just a few steps away! The second-level patio, with park bench, picnic table, and rocking chairs, faces the gulf, providing a wonderful setting to enjoy the sound of the waves crashing in the distance. Two long driveways and multiple access points ensure utmost convenience. And out back?

Seven sun-loungers invite you to bask in the summer sun next to the gorgeous private pool! The entertainment area also features a spa, large TV, and comfy seating, making it an ideal spot to unwind, just steps away from the serene Blue Mountain Beach. Nearby, stairs lead to a third-floor deck (observation tower?), prime for sunrise and sunset viewing! Inside is a gorgeous kitchen and dining room on the first level. On the other side of the kitchen is a comfortable living area with a sleeper sofa, large TV, and desk. The first level also includes a bunk room, with four twins, a guest room, king, and a primary bedroom, king. A mirrored layout unfolds on the second level, revealing an expansive kitchen, a large dining table, and a comfortable living area with a sleeper sofa. Nearby is a primary bedroom, king, guest bedroom, king, and a bunk room with four twins, each with TV and bathroom. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - Across the street is the deeded beach access - 6 bedrooms, 5 full bathrooms; 1 half bath - 3750 sq ft - 8 parking spots - Gas grill - Complimentary Wi-Fi - Private pool and spa (can be seasonally heated for an additional $65.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) - Several large wrap-around balconies - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; full private bath; walk-in shower; TV - King in 1st floor guest room; private bath; walk-in shower; TV - 4 twin bunks in 1st-floor guest room; private bath with walk-in shower - Pull-out sleeper sofa in 1st-floor den - King in 2nd floor primary; private bath; walk-in shower; TV - King in 2nd floor guest room; private bath; walk-in shower; TV - 4 twin bunks in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath with walk-in shower; TV - Full-size pull-out sleeper sofa in 2nd floor common area Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
